title: Factor decomposition across 4 dimensions: Momentum (30d return normalized by 90d
description: Factor decomposition across 4 dimensions: Momentum (30d return normalized by 90d vol), Carry (annualized funding rate), Crowding (OI-delta vs. price-delta divergence with crowded_long/crowded_short/unwinding/neutral regime), and Volatility (realized 30d vol percentile over full lookback). Returns composite 0-1 score with label (bullish_bias_low_vol / bullish_bias / neutral / bearish_bias / bearish_bias_high_vol). Informational research data — not investment advice.
